crossRefs.note: Then he brought me to the inner court by the south gate. He measured the south gate according to these measurements;
He brought me to the north gate, and he measured it according to these measurements;

translations.web: He brought me into the inner court toward the east. He measured the gate according to these measurements;
translations.bsb: And he brought me to the inner court on the east side, and he measured the gateway; it had the same measurements as the others.
translations.kjv: And he brought me into the inner court toward the east: and he measured the gate according to these measures.
translations.asv: And he brought me into the inner court toward the east: and he measured the gate according to these measures;
